pages.title: Magolor Greeting Kirby Beside the Crashed Lor Starcutter Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor greets Kirby beside the crashed Lor Starcutter in this printable coloring page, raising one mittened hand as the tilted ship rests among scattered rocks. Kirby looks up from the foreground. Magolor's striped hood tips and scarf buckle add detail, while the plain sky leaves the characters clearly outlined.

pages.title: Magolor Showing Kirby the Missing Parts of the Lor Starcutter on a Screen Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Magolor explaining the Lor Starcutter's missing parts to Kirby, pointing at a screen displaying a mast, an oar, and a wing. Curved ship walls and riveted supports frame the characters. The coloring sheet combines the large display with smaller costume emblems and control-room panels.

pages.title: Magolor and Kirby Repairing a Gear Mechanism Inside the Lor Starcutter Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor and Kirby repair a gear mechanism inside the Lor Starcutter in this printable coloring page, lifting a large cog above the exposed machinery below. A round riveted window sits behind them. Gear teeth, spokes, and shafts create mechanical details alongside the characters' broad face, hood, and scarf areas.

pages.title: Magolor Receiving a Recovered Energy Sphere From Kirby Inside the Lor Starcutter Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor receives a recovered Energy Sphere from Kirby inside the Lor Starcutter in this printable coloring page, with both characters holding its gear-shaped outer frame. Stars and clouds appear through the large window behind them. Curved floor panels and costume emblems add smaller sections around the central circular object.

pages.title: Magolor Piloting the Restored Lor Starcutter Through a Dimensional Rift Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor pilots the restored Lor Starcutter through a dimensional rift in this printable coloring page, standing at the wheel beneath a wide window full of stars. A large star-shaped opening and sweeping lines mark the route ahead. Wheel spokes and costume trim add smaller details within the broad cockpit scene.

pages.title: Magolor Rescuing Kirby From a Bottomless Pit as Helper Magolor Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Helper Magolor rescuing Kirby from a bottomless pit, holding both of Kirby's raised arms above the gap between rocky ledges. Magolor's scarf trails to one side. The coloring sheet keeps the background open, with small hood patterns and cliff cracks around the rounded figures.

pages.title: Magolor Giving Kirby a Stamina Potion Before an Adventure Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor gives Kirby a stamina potion before an adventure in this printable coloring page, offering a round stoppered bottle beside a winding path and low bushes. Small bubbles appear inside the bottle, and stars float overhead. The coloring sheet has broad character areas with a few compact costume and potion details.

pages.title: Magolor Awakening in Another Dimension with Torn Robes and an Exposed Ear Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor awakens in Another Dimension in this printable coloring page, touching his head while his torn hood reveals one pointed ear above a cracked floating platform. Ragged scarf ends and holes in his robes emphasize the damaged clothing. Small drifting rocks add angular details around his large central figure.

pages.title: Magolor Collecting Floating Magic Points Above a Broken Platform Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Magolor collecting floating Magic Points above a broken platform, reaching toward a row of faceted crystals surrounded by short ray marks. His ragged cape and scarf trail behind him. The coloring sheet contrasts pointed crystal sections and cracked rock surfaces with his rounded hood and hands.

pages.title: Magolor Firing a Magic Sphere Through a Row of Star Blocks Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor fires a Magic Sphere through star blocks in this printable coloring page, extending one hand as a round projectile breaks the first block into fragments. Two intact blocks remain beside it on a narrow platform. The open background emphasizes the small action scene, costume trim, and geometric block details.

pages.title: Magolor Charging Through Breakable Blocks with Magolor Surge Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor charges through breakable blocks with Magolor Surge in this printable coloring page, surrounded by sweeping motion trails, scattered stars, and fragments of star-marked cubes. Stars also decorate his raised gloves. Angular rubble and curling trails fill much of the coloring sheet around his pointed hood and flowing cape.

pages.title: Magolor Protecting Himself Inside a Star-shaped Magic Barrier Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Magolor protecting himself inside a star-shaped magic barrier, raising both open hands while small impact bursts strike its double-lined border. His pointed hood, square scarf buckle, and patterned cape remain visible inside. Wide spaces within the barrier contrast with its narrow outlined edge.

pages.title: Magolor Creating a Black Hole That Draws in Nearby Enemies Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor creates a black hole that draws in nearby enemies in this printable coloring page, raising his hands beneath a large star-shaped spiral and curved motion lines. Two enemies hover near opposite sides of the vortex. Spiral bands dominate the upper section, with broad costume panels below on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Magolor Raising Deadly Needles From the Ground Beneath an Enemy Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor raises Deadly Needles beneath an enemy in this printable coloring page, directing magic toward three tall spikes emerging from fractured ground below a one-eyed creature. Small sparkles and curved trails connect his hands to the attack. The coloring sheet combines narrow pointed forms with broad character and landscape areas.

pages.title: Magolor Discovering His First Fruit Fragment in Another Dimension Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Magolor discovering his first Fruit Fragment in Another Dimension, reaching toward a sparkling piece hovering above an ornamented stone pedestal. Floating islands and loose rocks surround the platform. Tears in his hood and scarf add irregular clothing details beside the pedestal's geometric bands.

pages.title: Magolor Dodging Lightning Bolts From Electricky Dooter Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor dodges lightning bolts from Electricky Dooter in this printable coloring page, sweeping sideways between floating rock platforms as jagged bolts strike above and below him. Electricky Dooter hovers overhead in a broad pointed hat topped by a bulb. Portal-like rings and small shards add detail around the action.

pages.title: Magolor Hovering Above Fiery Puffer's Rolling Attack Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor hovers above Fiery Puffer's rolling attack in this printable coloring page, spreading his hands as the large spiked enemy rushes across a rocky landscape. Curved motion lines surround the round body and trailing fins. Magolor's ragged clothing and the scattered stones add smaller details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Magolor Surrounded By the Four Rampaging Doomers Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Magolor surrounded by four Rampaging Doomers, each with pointed wings, a beak, and ring-like ornaments beside its head. He floats above a cracked platform with both hands extended. Torn scarf edges, drifting shards, and repeated feather shapes make the composition densely detailed.

pages.title: Magolor Confronting Crowned Doomer Above the Ethereal Altar Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor confronts Crowned Doomer above the Ethereal Altar in this printable coloring page, facing a winged enemy with a central crown gem and eye-patterned feathers. Floating crystals hang between them. The circular altar, broken columns, and stair edges add architectural sections beneath the airborne characters on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Magolor Carrying the Gem Apple Sapling Through a Dimensional Rift Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor carries the Gem Apple sapling through a dimensional rift in this printable coloring page, holding its round base and two leafy shoots before an oval portal. Torn cape edges trail behind him, and small sparkles surround the opening. Broad portal bands contrast with the sapling's leaves and costume patterns.

pages.title: Magolor Planting the Gem Apple Sapling in the Dream Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Magolor planting the Gem Apple sapling in the Dream Kingdom, lowering its exposed roots into a small hole among mounds of soil. A tower and pointed-roof houses stand beyond the hills. Leaf veins, roots, and costume borders add smaller details around his large hood.

pages.title: Magolor in His Woven Shopkeeper Robes Holding a Gem Apple Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor wears his woven shopkeeper robes while holding a Gem Apple in this printable coloring page, cupping the faceted fruit beneath his thick ribbed scarf. A zigzag border frames his hood, and stitching marks the sleeves. The coloring sheet emphasizes the apple's angular panels against rounded hands and broad fabric areas.

pages.title: Magolor Trading a Sword to Sword Hero Kirby at His Shoppe Counter Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor trades a sword to Sword Hero Kirby at his Shoppe counter in this printable coloring page, with jars, a chest, and a hanging lantern nearby. Kirby reaches toward the decorated hilt while wearing a long cap. Wooden shelving, floorboards, and the sword's segmented blade add varied detail to the scene.

pages.title: Magolor Opening His Shoppe with Weapons and Armor Displayed on Shelves Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor opens his Shoppe in this printable coloring page, welcoming visitors through an arched door while swords, helmets, shields, and armor fill the shelves behind him. A star decorates the open door. The coloring sheet includes numerous equipment shapes alongside the stone floor, wooden panels, and Magolor's large central figure.

pages.title: Magolor Watching Bandana Waddle Dee Harvest the Gem Apple Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Magolor watching Bandana Waddle Dee harvest the Gem Apple tree, reaching for a faceted apple beneath its rounded leafy canopy. Houses and a distant castle appear beyond a fence. Angular fruit panels and individual leaves provide small sections around the characters and tree trunk.

pages.title: Magolor Welcoming Kirby to Merry Magoland in His Manager Top Hat and Bow Tie Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor welcomes Kirby to Merry Magoland in this printable coloring page, wearing a manager's top hat and bow tie beside a large character-shaped entrance arch. Flags, banners, and a distant castle frame the path. His patterned coat and the gate's small towers give the coloring sheet distinct costume and park details.

pages.title: Magolor Celebrating Kirby's Completed Missions with Waddle Dee Park Visitors Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor celebrates Kirby's completed missions with Waddle Dee park visitors in this printable coloring page, raising both hands above Kirby's star-shaped award and falling confetti. Two Waddle Dees stand beside Kirby beneath bunting and star-topped posts. The coloring sheet combines bold character outlines with small decorations and costume emblems.

pages.title: Magolor Dressed as a Professor Directing Kirby to a Matching Magic Tome Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor dresses as a professor and directs Kirby to a matching magic tome in this printable coloring page, wearing a mortarboard, large mustache, and gear-shaped medallion. A thought bubble repeats the star emblem on the book's cover. Shelved books and an arched window add rectangular and curved background sections.

pages.title: Magolor Dressed as a Ninja Beside the Ninja Dojo Targets Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor dresses as a ninja beside the Ninja Dojo targets in this printable coloring page, wearing a tied headband with a throwing-star emblem above his scarf. Two circular targets hang against the wooden wall. Concentric rings, small headband rivets, and floorboards add geometric details around his rounded figure.

pages.title: Magolor Facing Samurai Kirby While Holding a Miniature Lor Starcutter Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Magolor facing Samurai Kirby while holding a miniature Lor Starcutter, with a star-decorated wall scroll behind their practice area. Kirby wears a tied headband and grips a sword. The tiny ship's sail, flag, and hull markings provide finer details beside the broad character shapes.

pages.title: Magolor Racing Sword Kirby Through a Toy-block Challenge Course Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor races Sword Kirby through a toy-block challenge course in this printable coloring page, floating behind Kirby as he leaps across large rectangular blocks with his sword raised. A small block-built arch stands nearby. Speed lines and flowing cape edges add movement, while the blocks offer broad flat coloring spaces.

pages.title: Magolor Joining Kirby as a Dream Friend Beneath a Friend Heart Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor joins Kirby as a Dream Friend beneath a Friend Heart in this printable coloring page, with both characters raising a hand under the large outlined heart. Low hills, bushes, and star-marked pillars frame the scene. Wide character shapes and the open heart dominate this simple coloring sheet.

pages.title: Magolor Launching Kirby Aboard a Miniature Lor Starcutter with Magoloran Launch Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Magolor launching Kirby aboard a miniature Lor Starcutter with Magoloran Launch, sending the star-decorated ship upward along curving motion trails. Kirby sits beneath its sail while Magolor reaches after it. Repeated stars, a wing-shaped hull detail, and scarf trim add smaller coloring sections.

pages.title: Magolor Summoning Revolution Flame Around an Approaching Enemy Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor summons Revolution Flame around an approaching enemy in this printable coloring page, spreading both hands above a round character encircled by curling tongues of fire. Small rocks and low cliffs mark the ground. The flame shapes create sweeping open sections around the more compact costume and facial details.

pages.title: Magolor Tossing Gem Apple Bombs in Kirby Star Allies Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor tosses Gem Apple Bombs in this Kirby Star Allies printable coloring page, with two faceted apples carrying star emblems and short burning fuses around him. Floating islands and clouds fill the lower background. Polygonal fruit panels, curved motion marks, and patterned cape borders create varied details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Magolor Floating Beside Marx as Marx Balances on His Ball Coloring Page
pages.description: Magolor floats beside Marx as Marx balances on his ball in this printable coloring page, surrounded by outlined stars and rounded bushes in the background. Marx wears a two-pointed patterned cap above the star-decorated ball. The coloring sheet combines large curved panels with smaller costume patterns and facial features.

pages.title: Magolor Playing a Tambourine Beside Festival Kirby During Festival Dance Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Magolor playing a tambourine beside Festival Kirby during Festival Dance, with confetti, bunting, and draped decorations framing the performers onstage. Kirby wears a feathered headdress with a star centerpiece. Feather veins and tambourine jingles add fine details around the broad character and stage shapes.

pages.title: Kirby Magolor in Giant Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Magolor appear inside a giant tree in this printable coloring page, standing on a thick branch beneath curling limbs, hanging fruit, and individual leaves. A rectangular border contains the dense woodland scene. Wood-grain lines and layered branches create detailed sections around the two small central characters.

pages.title: Kirby Magolor in Dream Land Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Magolor visit Dream Land in this printable coloring page, floating above flowers and grass beneath a smiling cloud, leafy tree, and rounded distant hills. Small stars are scattered around the characters. The coloring sheet leaves plenty of open space between its simple landscape shapes and patterned costume borders.

pages.title: Kirby Magolor in Royal Throne Room Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kirby and Magolor seated in a royal throne room, holding wands on ornate chairs decorated with stars, crescents, and curled armrests. Kirby wears a crown, and matching footstools sit below them. Tall arches and patterned columns make the room a detailed setting for the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kirby Magolor in Waddle Dee Town Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Magolor visit Waddle Dee Town in this printable coloring page, standing among small houses, benches, flowers, and two Waddle Dees in the village square. A castle rises behind the rooftops, and Kirby wears a star headband. Magolor's scarf buckle and the windows add compact details to the open scene.

pages.title: Kirby Magolor in Seaside Village Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kirby and Magolor in a seaside village, beside a moored boat and a paved waterfront lined with tiled-roof houses and fences. Magolor winks beneath a small crown, while a lighthouse stands beyond the harbor. Rigging, roof tiles, and paving stones add many smaller coloring sections.

pages.title: Kirby Magolor on Floating Island Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Magolor appear on a floating island in this printable coloring page, surrounded by clouds beneath a large crescent moon and scattered outlined stars. Grass and a few rocks cover the island's top, with pointed stone sections underneath. The coloring sheet offers broad sky, character, and island areas.

pages.title: Kirby Magolor Above the Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Magolor float above the clouds in this printable coloring page, with Kirby raising one arm beside Magolor's outstretched hands and trailing cape panels. Overlapping cloud banks fill the lower half of the scene. Broad cloud shapes and open sky contrast with the small hood patterns and scarf buckle.

pages.title: Kirby Magolor in Magical Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Kirby and Magolor in a magical forest, following a winding path beneath spiral-marked trees and small stars hanging from branches. Magolor wears a crown and winks beside Kirby. Flowers, pointed leaves, and scattered star shapes create detailed borders around the central characters.

pages.title: Kirby Magolor in Treasure Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Magolor explore a treasure cave in this printable coloring page, beside an open chest, stacked coins, faceted gems, a crown, and a sword. Stalactites hang above the rocky passage, and smaller treasures rest on ledges. The coloring sheet combines broad cave walls with many compact treasure details.

pages.title: Kirby Magolor in Popstar Countryside Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Magolor travel through the Popstar countryside in this printable coloring page, following a winding road past leafy trees, scattered stones, and distant pointed mountains. A large star floats above Kirby. The broad path and open sky leave spacious areas around the small plants and Magolor's patterned hood.
